title: From Memory Access to Evidence Sufficiency: Diagnosing and Addressing Demand--Evidence Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.32088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory retrieval often returns query-relevant records, but relevance does not guarantee sufficient evidence: answering requires a set of records that jointly satisfies a question's factual, relational, temporal, and state constraints. We study this demand--evidence misalignment through MemPath, an interventional framework that diagnoses failures in memory access, demand coverage, and evidence utilization. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose BiDE-Mem, which represents questions as typed demands and uses them to guide retrieval and evidence organization. We formalize demand--evidence support; in the evaluated compact path, it is conveyed through provenance-aware evidence organization and Reader guidance rather than a separate generative four-state verification step. On LoCoMo, BiDE-Mem improves accuracy by 6.23 percentage points over Mnemis; on LongMemEval, it achieves 91.80%, with strong multi-hop and temporal performance. Supp

translated_title: 从记忆访问到证据充分性：诊断并解决需求-证据错位问题
translated_abstract: 长期记忆检索通常能返回与查询相关的记录，但相关性并不保证证据充分：回答问题需要一组能够共同满足问题的事实、关系、时间和状态约束的记录。我们通过 MemPath 研究这种需求-证据错位问题，MemPath 是一个干预性框架，用于诊断记忆访问、需求覆盖和证据利用方面的失败。在该诊断的指导下，我们提出了 BiDE-Mem，它将问题表示为类型化需求，并利用这些需求来指导检索和证据组织。我们对需求-证据支持进行了形式化定义；在所评估的紧凑路径中，这种支持通过溯源感知的证据组织和 Reader 指导来体现，而非通过单独的生成式四态验证步骤。在 LoCoMo 基准上，BiDE-Mem 相比 Mnemis 将准确率提升了 6.23 个百分点；在 LongMemEval 基准上，它达到了 91.80% 的准确率，在多跳推理和时间推理方面表现出色。
tldr: 该论文提出 MemPath 干预性诊断框架揭示长期记忆检索中“相关不等于充分”的需求-证据错位问题，并据此提出 BiDE-Mem 方法，将问题表示为类型化需求以指导检索与溯源感知的证据组织，在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 基准上取得显著准确率提升。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MemPath, an interventional framework to diagnose demand-evidence misalignment in long-term memory retrieval, and introduces BiDE-Mem, which represents questions as typed demands to guide retrieval and provenance-aware evidence organization, achieving significant accuracy gains on LoCoMo and LongMemEval benchmarks.
